repair.finding: npm rejects a command that supplies the same /dev/null file as both --userconfig and --globalconfig (double-loading config).
repair.change: The image creates two distinct empty trusted config files under /opt/orloom-verifier/npm-config, supplies each explicitly to the digest-pinned bundled npm CLI, and removes both after the scripts-disabled locked install.

regression.static: Asserts distinct created image config paths and rejects /dev/null reuse.
regression.behavioral: Runs npm config get with two fresh empty paths and a sanitized environment. It discovers the image-bundled /opt/orloom-verifier/npm/bin/npm-cli.js first when present, so the verifier image executes the probe without requiring npm on PATH; environments with no known CLI explicitly skip only this local behavior probe.

unresolved: No Docker build or runsc/host proof was authorized; image construction remains for controller review and separately authorized runtime validation.
This source validation does not establish a final image digest or certification.
